clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Tonga Runetotem watches the Barrens' oases grow sick. Sent from Thunder Bluff, the tauren druid studies a corruption harming the region's wildlife and seeks its source before the fragile ecosystem fails.

At the Crossroads, Tonga Runetotem studies the Barrens' changing land. His elders in Thunder Bluff sent him from Mulgore, and he knows the dry savannah well. Where travelers see scrub and predators, Tonga watches for signs of the land's health. Lately, those signs have turned troubling. He seeks travelers who can help him investigate the scattered oases, the heart of life across the savannah.

Tonga bears the Runetotem clan name and the druidic heritage championed by Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem. Hamuul keeps ties with the Cenarion Circle and studies in Moonglade's sacred groves, while scouts like Tonga serve on the frontier. Tonga draws on Moonglade's botanical wisdom to prepare healing salves and counter poisons. His work puts the young tauren druidic tradition to use within the fledgling Horde.
